## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Failed saves should be reported because the command currently announces success even when it creates no report.

## Changes
The pull request adds report saving with a destination announcement and cleanup that tolerates already absent temporary files.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Report write failures before announcing success — When the destination’s parent directory is missing, `save_report` discards `FileNotFoundError`, prints a success message, and returns `0` without creating a file. The handler also swallows other `OSError` failures. — Callers cannot detect failed saves, so report delivery can fail without triggering recovery. — Fix: Propagate the error or report failure with a nonzero result, and announce success only after writing succeeds.
